styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Museums, galleries and the rebuilt downtown.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Roman ruins, Ottoman lanes and war memory.

stays.why: Walk to Martyrs' Square, the Grand Serail and the National Museum area; central for taxis. Quieter at night.
Student quarter with cheap eats, cafés and the American University; good bus links and a short walk to the Corniche.
Old-house streets full of bars and restaurants; walkable to Downtown and Mar Mikhael nightlife.
Leafy, calmer residential area with hotels, cafés and malls; easy taxi rides across town.

food: Start with mezze: hummus, moutabal, tabbouleh and kibbeh. Order a few plates and share.
Try a mixed grill and Lebanese sweets like knafeh and baklava; portions are large, so share.
Hamra and Gemmayzeh have the widest choice of cheap and mid-range places; prices vary, so check the bill.
Ask if prices are in LBP or USD; both are quoted, and the rate can differ. Confirm before you order.
Alcohol is widely served in bars and restaurants. Dress is casual; book popular dinner spots at weekends.
more_time: Add a day for Byblos (Jbeil): ancient harbour and crusader castle, roughly an hour north by car or bus.
Swap an afternoon for the Jeita Grotto and Harissa cable car; check opening days on the day.
Beach clubs along the coast north and south of the city fill in summer; book ahead on weekends.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the downtown, the museum and a Corniche walk, with an evening in Gemmayzeh or Mar Mikhael.

month_notes: January: cool and wet, highs near 16°C and about 14 rain days. Pack a rain jacket.
February: similar to January, around 17°C, with fewer rain days (about 9).
March: mild at 19°C but rainy again, about 13 rain days.
April: warming to 22°C and drier, about 7 rain days. Good for walking.
May: pleasant at 26°C with only about 5 rain days. Beach season starts.
June: hot and dry, 29°C highs, about 2 rain days. Plan shade at midday.
July: hot and dry, 31°C highs, no rain expected. Beach and evening plans.
August: hottest and most humid, 31°C high and 25°C low, no rain.
September: still hot at 30°C with about 2 rain days. Sea stays warm.
October: comfortable at 28°C, about 5 rain days. A strong month to visit.
November: cooler at 23°C but wetter, about 9 rain days.
December: cool and wet, 19°C highs and about 11 rain days. Bring layers.

climate_guide.summary: Mediterranean climate: mild, wet winters and hot, dry summers by the sea.

items.title: Best time: May to October
items.text: Warm to hot days, little rain and a warm sea. July and August are hottest and most humid.

items.title: Wet winter (December to March)
items.text: About 9–14 rain days a month and highs of 16–19°C. Showers can be heavy; carry a rain jacket.

items.title: Hot, humid summer
items.text: Highs of 29–31°C with warm nights around 22–25°C. Sightsee early or late; rest at midday.

items.title: Spring and autumn are mild
items.text: April, May, October and November are comfortable for walking, with some rain in spring and autumn.

items.title: Sea and beach season
items.text: Beach clubs are busiest June to September. Sea is warmest in late summer.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Light clothes and sunscreen for summer; a light layer for evenings; a rain jacket and umbrella for winter.

transit.best: Walk in the centre and on the Corniche; use taxi or ride apps for longer trips.

modes.text: No metro or tram. Don't plan around rail in the city.
OCFTC blue-and-white buses and LCC red minibuses cost LBP500–1,000; flag them at the roadside.

Shared 'service' taxis charge a fixed LBP2,000 per person; agree the price first. Hail-taxis charge per destination, not distance; a cross-town ride is around LBP10,000. Uber and Bolt work; airport rides are often a fixed fare.
Driving is heavy and aggressive. Only rent if you plan trips outside the city.
Best in the compact centre and on the Corniche. Use taxis for longer or late-night trips.
